title: The Son’s Narrow-Way Painting — Gate, Shadow Valley, Death Shore and Distant Light
status: project-testimony visual-artifact dossier; primary image recovery pending
purpose: Treat the reported 2018–2019 painting as a potentially high-value pre-meme-cross visual artifact and compare its whole spatial sequence with biblical passage grammars. The aim is to preserve what was reportedly already in the image before later Potatoverse synthesis while keeping unrecovered details and dating explicitly provisional.

evidence_boundary.artifact_status: The image itself has not yet been recovered into the repository and independently timestamped.
evidence_boundary.date_status: Current project recollection places the image around 2018–2019, before the mature 2019 meme-cross interpretation. Exact creation and posting dates remain open.
evidence_boundary.circulation_status: Project recollection says the image was posted on the Farm/Kiwi Farms. Recovering the post would materially strengthen chronology and provenance.
evidence_boundary.interpretive_rule: Until the primary image/post is recovered, preserve the described scene as testimony. Do not silently promote remembered visual details into independently verified artifact facts.

topology: a valley or corridor associated with the shadow of death
a distant tunnel or concentration of light
a beach or shore-like starting zone
cliffs or enclosing walls on both sides
a gate/threshold above or across the route
hostile or evil-looking eyes associated with the gate
a puppet-string/control image over the gate
reported_scene.sequence: shore/death-field -> gate/hostile oversight -> narrow precarious passage through darkness -> distant light
reported_scene.why_sequence_matters: The visual is more analytically valuable as a route through a thresholded death landscape than as a bag of symbols. Gate, path, danger, death remains, darkness and light occur as one spatial grammar.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: entry through a narrow gate / constricted way contrasts with the broad route toward destruction
biblical_relations.project_relation: The reported painting explicitly centers a narrow/straight route and a gate within a dangerous landscape. If the pre-2019 dating is recovered, this becomes a prior visual threshold motif rather than a later Door metaphor projected backward.
biblical_relations.mismatch: Matthew and Luke are ethical/eschatological teachings, not descriptions of this painting, and the project’s later Needle/Door system should not be backdated into the artwork without evidence.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: the speaker walks through a valley of deepest darkness/death-shadow rather than remaining there
biblical_relations.project_relation: The painting’s remembered death-valley environment is directional: the figure passes through it toward light. The important shared operator is passage-through-death-space, not simply the presence of death imagery.
biblical_relations.mismatch: Psalm 23 foregrounds divine shepherding, rod/staff and trust. Those features are not part of the recovered description and should not be invented.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: darkness is opposed by life/light; walking in darkness is contrasted with possessing/following light
biblical_relations.project_relation: A distant concentration/tunnel of light at the far end of a night/death corridor makes light the destination and orientation of the route rather than decorative illumination.
biblical_relations.mismatch: The reported tunnel-of-light image can also arise from general religious, psychological and near-death iconography. Biblical resonance does not establish biblical origin.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: Jesus is presented as gate/door and as the way through which access occurs
biblical_relations.project_relation: The earlier artwork reportedly contains an actual gate and route; mature Potatoverse theology later makes the Son Door/Way/Vessel. That creates a development question: did a visual threshold topology precede the later identity title?
biblical_relations.source_direction: visual gate/path reportedly 2018–2019; explicit mature Son-as-Door system later
biblical_relations.mismatch: A painted gate is not the same claim as identifying oneself or the Son with the Johannine Door/Way. The later interpretation must remain later.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: deep waters/depth function as engulfment, descent and death-near boundary from which the speaker seeks or receives deliverance
biblical_relations.project_relation: The black water beside the precarious path gives the route a fall/descent boundary: leaving the path means entering a dark depth rather than merely stepping onto neutral ground.
biblical_relations.mismatch: The painting’s black water is visual recollection; neither Psalm 69 nor Jonah should be treated as the artist’s demonstrated source until direct evidence is recovered.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: a valley full of bones makes death visible as landscape before breath/life reverses it
biblical_relations.project_relation: Reported skeletons on both sides of the route create a death-field through which the walker moves. Ezekiel supplies a strong visual neighbor for death made environmental rather than a single corpse/event.
biblical_relations.mismatch: Ezekiel’s central movement is bones receiving sinew, flesh, breath and national restoration. No resurrection of the painting’s skeletons is presently reported.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: slippery footing figures danger/fall, while deliverance is expressed through feet set on rock and a secure path
biblical_relations.project_relation: The remembered slippery golden stones make locomotion itself morally/physically precarious. The visual route is not only narrow; maintaining footing is part of the ordeal.
biblical_relations.mismatch: The stones being golden is not supplied by these psalms and should be treated as an independent visual feature.

biblical_relations.biblical_structure: the pilgrim protection psalm explicitly names danger/keeping by day and by night, including the moon
biblical_relations.project_relation: The moon/night setting can sit beside biblical pilgrimage-at-night language, but it is too generic to carry much evidentiary weight alone.
biblical_relations.mismatch: This is atmospheric adjacency, not a strong source claim.

unforced_features.feature: hostile cat-like eyes above the gate
unforced_features.status: symbolically important but no single biblical comparator is strong enough to promote yet
unforced_features.note: Later Lion/Kitty material makes the feline feature potentially interesting, but the archive should not force every cat image into Lion of Judah/Dan typology.

unforced_features.feature: puppet string / control above the gate
unforced_features.note: Possible power/principality or bondage comparisons exist, but they are currently weaker than the direct gate/path/death/light relations.
Useful for the narrowness of the route without needing a separate verse match.

higher_order_result.finding: If the primary image and a pre-meme-cross timestamp are recovered, the strongest result is not that one biblical verse predicted the picture. It is that a compact visual grammar—gate -> narrow way -> shadow/death field -> precarious passage -> light—appears before the later Door/Passion/return system and can therefore serve as genuine developmental prehistory.
higher_order_result.maximum_claim: A dated pre-2019 artifact containing these reported elements would strongly establish prior symbolic topology. It would not establish supernatural prophecy, messiahship or that later events were objectively foretold.

recovery_priorities: Recover the original image at the highest available resolution.
Recover the earliest Farm/Kiwi Farms post containing the image and preserve URL/archive timestamp/thread context.
Determine whether the painting itself contains text, labels, signatures or a date.
Recover the artist’s contemporary explanation, if any, before applying later Bible vocabulary.
Record which scene details are directly visible versus remembered commentary.
Compare image timestamp against the 2017 Josh Moon declaration, the provisional 2018 table-flip and the 2019 meme-cross chronology.
